decisions.what: Customer shipping: one charge per address too (Bobby). In one checkout, partner-made items going to the same address pay ONE shipping charge (the highest); the others ship free in the same package and the cart shows the saving. A-frames and other separately shipped items keep their own shipping. Live _shop1029ci.
Header: 'Order online' and 'Book a site walk' are now the exact same height on every page (44 px desktop, 36 px small laptop, 48 px phone; 202 pages + 31 shop pages, measured live).
New free page /shop/logo-cleanup/: upload a logo, see how large it prints sharp, remove the background, get the automatic vector version, download PNG + SVG. Nothing to order.

Dimensional catalog gaps added: cast letters with round or prismatic faces, 8 more lit acrylic styles (incl. trimless halo), and 3/8 in ADA raised print. 0 price mismatches server vs browser; old products unchanged.

Signs365 ordering: ONE partner order and ONE shipping charge per customer address (Bobby). Paid partner orders going to the same address by the same ship method are gathered for 30 minutes after the newest payment (3 h max), then built as one Signs365 cart with a line per order, paid together, PO = the lead order. The cart total is split across the orders by their estimated price so the margin guard still works per order. One tracking email and one review email per package. Example: Larry Banks' 3 orders on 10-13 (FBKN, AC8Q, XY4W) would have been one partner order with $10 shipping instead of three at $30.

Google review email on delivery: when the FedEx events in the partner portal show the package delivered (code DL), the customer gets one email asking for an honest Google review, with Bobby's B9Google QR code built in and a review button. The 10-day check-in no longer asks a second time.

Signage store direction set by Bobby: BUILD OUR OWN designer + cart on brand9signs.com (no Etsy, no SaaS tool). Differentiator = a live architectural-film FINISH picker (3M DI-NOC via Grimco: brushed metal, wood, stone, carbon, color-shift) + export that speaks the shop's language (film SKU + face as a job ticket). Stack: Fabric.js editor (text/logo/2-sided), 2D finish compositing (WebGL only for the lit glow), vector PDF with outlined fonts + job ticket, pricing.json, static site + serverless + Stripe Checkout. Build-our-own beats SaaS because the finish library and the shop-language export are the whole point and a rented widget won't bend. Top risk: RGB canvas -> CMYK/ICC shop print + outlined fonts -> FIRST task is one design round-tripped to a correct printed proof, then the MVP editor. Reverses the earlier Zakeke/Etsy lean. Plan: project doc b9-signage-store-and-design-tool-plan-2026-10-07.md. Pending from Bobby: printed-vs-applied finishes, the shop RIP/ICC, a 6-10 Grimco film shortlist, the A-frame/lit spec + a Stripe account.

Signage e-commerce + high-end design tool scoped via the Construct (Gatekeeper: orchestrator T2, owner-decision; Scout + design-tool scan + Ledger in parallel). Anchor product: double-sided A-frame / lit sidewalk signs (seen on RVLightBender Etsy, ~$342). Verdict: product is right and VistaPrint is beatable (no lit option), but the risk is DEMAND not the tool — B9's own store did ~12 orders in 2022-24 and GA4 shows ~0 e-comm in 365 days. Plan is staged: Phase 0 prove demand 30-60 days (1-2 made A-frames on Etsy + a Stripe Buy-Now, $300-500 ads, measure CAC and real shipping) BEFORE any tool; Phase 1 license Zakeke (flat, no per-order fee) skinned to the B9 brand, 3-5 templates, print-ready to the shop — not a $15-60k custom build; Phase 2 scale. Cart scope stays small shippable items only (military->estimate, barricades->never, builders->quote). Owner go/no-go pending on Phase 0 + 4 shop numbers. Plan: project doc b9-signage-store-and-design-tool-plan-2026-10-07.md.

MIMIC tool audited (github littledivy/mimic: capture your own app traffic -> Claude writes a Python client that replays your login). Verdict: adopt the PATTERN now (export our own HAR from a credentialed web tool -> AI-written typed client for Hermes, replacing slow browser-automation), adopt the TOOL only where a tool WE own has no API. Not for competitors or any account/data we don't own (ToS/legal), and never a replacement for GSC/GA4/GBP/IndexNow. Governance: a captured session is a live credential -> Mac-only like the APS secret, Gatekeeper owner-gated, codegen runs in the Code tab (claude -p is 'not logged in' headless). No clean B9 pilot right now: the slow manual tools (Yelp, Bing Places, Apple Business Connect) are third-party (ToS line), and the tools we own (site/SSH, SiteGround CLI, WordPress, GSC/GA4/GBP/IndexNow/Bing Webmaster) already have real APIs. Parked as a ready pattern; first pilot likely a future company's internal tool or a genuine API-less vendor portal. Full audit: project doc mimic-tool-audit-2026-10-07.md.
